real-ror.notes:
These are staged integration fixtures, not admitted production metadata. Source,
model, MeaningGraph and decision files preserve their pinned bytes. The exact ROR
binding derives `research-organization` from core `organization` in
`identity.meaning.yaml`; a concept name is not guessed as a file path.

The original source/validation.json is retained as original-validation.json.
The proposed additive native_key section was computed against the existing full
SQLite (141528 rows and distinct native IDs), and the metadata snapshot adds the
acyclic artifact/generator linkage needed by the proposed helper. These additions
are not present at the provider source pin and require independently reviewed
provider publication. No full SQLite, source dump or native key corpus is bundled.

The ROR user decision source is hub PR91 f8093950122e000aaccffefb7c478adeaf275fbf,
subsequently root-landed at 17263dbacabdfe95e53fc3c6980177416bdab941; its source and
provider scope pins are unchanged. Its acceptance does not establish runtime or
publication eligibility.

references.bytes:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: ror
name: Research Organization Registry source projection
description: >-
  Full ROR schema 2 records with native URL identity and all statuses.
  Locations and relationships are ordered physical projections of their source
  arrays, not extra logical public recordsets. Source bindings do not authorize
  any user identifier mapping or name-to-identity matching.
license: CC0-1.0
models:
  ror: ror.modelspec.hcl
sources:
  - id: ror-v2-13
    provider: Research Organization Registry
    dataset: ROR data release v2.13
    title: ROR schema 2 JSON release dated 2026-09-22
    license: CC0-1.0
    url: https://zenodo.org/records/22902037
    note: Embedded GeoNames location data is CC-BY-4.0; source/ror-v2.13.json pins archive and JSON member bytes.
concepts:
  - id: research-organization
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/organization?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Research organization
    description: >-
      An organization represented by ROR. This is a source-local organization
      role; it does not establish legal entity or LEI equivalence. All source
      statuses are retained. Native identifier URLs are byte-exact source keys.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///ror.organizations
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///ror.organizations
        property: id
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///ror.locations
        property: organization_id
        role: foreign-key
      - model: modelspec:///ror.relationships
        property: organization_id
        role: foreign-key
      - model: modelspec:///ror.relationships
        property: id
        role: foreign-key
        note: Source-declared relationship target; missing targets remain exceptions, not fabricated organizations.
  - id: geonames-feature-reference
    kind: attribute
    of: research-organization
    labels:
      en: GeoNames feature reference
    description: >-
      Source-declared locations.geonames_id in the GeoNames geonameid namespace.
      Many organization locations can reference zero or one feature each; an
      organization may have multiple locations. This does not classify every
      feature as a city or establish a user geocoder. Retain nulls and ordinals.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///ror.locations
        property: geonames_id
        role: value
        note: Accepted source-public reference; independent GeoNames closure report retains absent upstream targets.

format: meaning/draft-1
id: identity
name: People and organizations
description: People, organizations, and the roles people hold in an organization.
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: person
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Person
      ru: Человек
    synonyms:
      en: [individual, human, humans, persons]
      ru: [лицо, люди]
    description: An individual human being.

  - id: organization
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Organization
      ru: Организация
    synonyms:
      en: [organisation, company, business, firm]
      ru: [компания, фирма, предприятие]
    description: A group with a defined identity and purpose, such as a company.

  - id: employee
    kind: entity
    extends: person
    labels:
      en: Employee
      ru: Сотрудник
    synonyms:
      en: [staff member, worker, member of staff, colleague]
      ru: [работник, персонал]
    description: A person employed by an organization.

  - id: manager
    kind: attribute
    of: employee
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Manager
      ru: Руководитель
    synonyms:
      en: [boss, reports to, line manager, supervisor]
      ru: [начальник]
    description: The employee that another employee reports to.

real-geonames.notes:
These small metadata fixtures preserve exact bytes from corrected GeoNames build
873538b63de475f8a04f5accdd9a14e51e59e90a: snapshot SHA256
3fce69153378a0af22f049af8bcd507e3e79ba34b2020ac767cee6c0ee4977bc and keys SHA256
c57b21174d0f0d2badd575cf1c2605840bc862e6cebd52064ceffd9c266ee9c8. The namespace is
GeoNames:countryInfoISO2, including historical source keys; it is not a claim of
universal current ISO membership. Source Chinook and decision references preserve
their exact canonical pins and the actual assertions/$records path.

contract.json is a proposed format2 label-bridge attachment, not published provider
admission. No serving dataset or bulk source data is bundled. references.json
records the byte-exact captured documents used by offline integration tests.

format: meaning/draft-1
id: geonames
name: GeoNames source projection
license: CC0-1.0
description: >-
  Source-specific GeoNames recordsets and accepted country identifier roles.
  CountryInfo includes provider-retained historic entries; snapshot coverage is
  independent of current ISO membership. Gazetteer features are not all cities.
  Raw demo labels obtain scope only through the separately validated publisher
  representation attachment, not through labels matching in this graph.
models:
  geonames: geonames.modelspec.hcl
concepts:
  - id: geonames-country
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    description: Country or territory records as retained in the pinned GeoNames countryInfo snapshot.
    labels: {en: GeoNames country}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_countries
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_countries
        property: iso
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_countries
        property: country
        role: display-name
  - id: geonames-admin
    kind: entity
    description: >-
      Provider admin1 rows identified by the raw country.admin1 composite,
      including unresolved country references. These codes are not universally ISO3166-2.
    labels: {en: GeoNames admin1 record}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_admin1
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_admin1
        property: code
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_admin1
        property: name
        role: display-name
  - id: geonames-feature
    kind: entity
    description: >-
      One native GeoNames gazetteer feature in the selected ID union. All original
      feature classes/codes remain available; this does not extend core city.
    labels: {en: GeoNames feature}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_places
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_places
        property: geonameid
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_places
        property: name
        role: display-name
  - id: geonames-alternate-name
    kind: entity
    description: Native alternate-name rows with exact language, text, flags and periods for retained feature IDs.
    labels: {en: GeoNames alternate name}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_alternate_names
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_alternate_names
        property: alternate_name_id
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_alternate_names
        property: alternate_name
        role: display-name
  - id: projected-country-code
    kind: dimension
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    description: >-
      Exact native alpha2 target code in each separately scoped reviewed bridge.
      No raw label acceptance is inferred from these target-property bindings.
    labels: {en: Projected country code}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_chinook_customer_country
        property: target_key
        role: value
        match: codes.alpha2
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_northwind_customer_country
        property: target_key
        role: value
        match: codes.alpha2
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_northwind_order_country
        property: target_key
        role: value
        match: codes.alpha2
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_pubs_publisher_country
        property: target_key
        role: value
        match: codes.alpha2

This is explicitly native-identifier execution against actual small GeoNames
metadata, with a hypothetical interchange input and decision. No accepted
source-to-native user scope, native Geo eligibility or production admission is
created. The real-geonames directory separately covers the reviewed label bridge.

The preserved source/generation-snapshot.json bytes are 7941 bytes with SHA256
d564721b80809537424d17b2bf2276697593a3cb380ea020f33c070e1ff0e7ab, including the

references.bytes:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: geonames
name: GeoNames source projection
license: CC0-1.0
description: >-
  Source-specific GeoNames recordsets and accepted country identifier roles.
  CountryInfo includes provider-retained historic entries; snapshot coverage is
  independent of current ISO membership. Gazetteer features are not all cities.
  Raw demo labels obtain scope only through the separately validated publisher
  representation attachment, not through labels matching in this graph.
models:
  geonames: geonames.modelspec.hcl
concepts:
  - id: geonames-country
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    description: Country or territory records as retained in the pinned GeoNames countryInfo snapshot.
    labels: {en: GeoNames country}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_countries
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_countries
        property: iso
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_countries
        property: country
        role: display-name
  - id: geonames-admin
    kind: entity
    description: >-
      Provider admin1 rows identified by the raw country.admin1 composite,
      including unresolved country references. These codes are not universally ISO3166-2.
    labels: {en: GeoNames admin1 record}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_admin1
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_admin1
        property: code
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_admin1
        property: name
        role: display-name
  - id: geonames-feature
    kind: entity
    description: >-
      One native GeoNames gazetteer feature in the selected ID union. All original
      feature classes/codes remain available; this does not extend core city.
    labels: {en: GeoNames feature}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_places
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_places
        property: geonameid
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_places
        property: name
        role: display-name

    labels: {en: GeoNames alternate name}
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_alternate_names
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_alternate_names
        property: alternate_name_id
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///geonames.geonames_alternate_names
        property: alternate_name
        role: display-name
